explanation: This code shows the invocation count thresholds used for tiering decisions. Key thresholds include: invocation_count_for_maglev (400/1000), invocation_count_for_maglev_osr (100), invocation_count_for_turbofan (3000), and invocation_count_for_osr (500). The InterruptBudgetFor function calculates interrupt budgets based on these thresholds and bytecode length, controlling when functions are considered for optimization.
